items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: when Happy got together, well, it was hard to tell who was who. Some say I was the best, some say he was the best.

ctx.x: Yeah, Kid Ory's band. Okay. I know, as Ory told me once, he used to use Henry Martin on drums too some. On drums, yeah. But not all the time.
Yeah, I see, uh, in those times before his feet got bad. But then you had another fella named Happy. Oh, yes, that's right.
I've heard of him. Red Happy, huh? Red Happy.
